title: a registry tree on one deployable, and an `auth: required` deployable beside it hosting only `crossTenant` data

apiCaller.e2eLess: The defect is a COMPILE failure on the deployable that does NOT host the tenant registry (node TS2339 `schema.orgs`, .NET CS0246/CS1061, elixir an undefined schema module), so the corpus compile legs are its oracle.  Two deployables, so the behavioural runner cannot pick one.  Signed with its reason in gate-ledger's BEHAVIOURAL_ABSENT.
